Class ResourceUUIDParameterRenderer

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractParameterRenderer<Object>
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.AbstractChipParameterRenderer
uno.anahata.asi.swing.agi.message.part.tool.param.ResourceUUIDParameterRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParameterRenderer<Object>
public class ResourceUUIDParameterRenderer extends AbstractChipParameterRenderer
A specialized parameter renderer for an individual Resource UUID.

Extends AbstractChipParameterRenderer to display a compact green pill/chip showing the Resource Name. It caches the name so it remains visible even if the resource is later unloaded from the context window. Supports full in-place editing, opening in IDE, and removal. When placed inside a collection, it is composed by a list container such as WrapListParameterRenderer.
